# Personal Projects (PP) — R&D Workbench
> Canonical URL: https://steven.kleynenberg.com/pp/
> Author: Steven Kleynenberg (Delft, The Netherlands)
> Parent Index: https://steven.kleynenberg.com/llms.txt

## Overview
Personal Projects (PP) documents the experimental software, digital signal processing (DSP), and automation toolchains built on Steven Kleynenberg's Fedora Linux workstation.

## Highlighted Workbench Projects
1. AudioTap v18a Gemini Master - Neuro-Acoustic Edition (com.kleynenberg.audiotap):
   - Zero-AndroidX, zero-Gradle pure Java 17 / Android SDK 34 application built via Makefile (aapt, javac, d8, zipalign, apksigner).
   - 10-band WebAudio Biquad equalizer (32 Hz – 16 kHz) with cybernetic RMS homeostasis auto-cut/auto-boost on unpinned bands, haptic fader detents, and dual HTML5 Canvas Technics VU meters with damping-oil viscosity and thermal peg glow physics.
   - Foreground AudioService with MediaSession lockscreen controls, ALLOW_CAPTURE_BY_ALL audio capture policy, and SAF file chooser compatibility for Nexus 9 (API 24) and Pixel 10.
2. Local Project Trawler (local_project_trawler.py v3.1.1):
   - Deterministic AST/code-DNA analyzer with hard privacy-sandbox exclusions, SHA-256 incremental hashing, and automated documentation synthesis.
3. GemSide MCP Bridge & Linux Tooling:
   - Chrome Side Panel extension + Python Native Messaging host bridge, BLE biometric readers, and LoRaWAN edge telemetry scripts.

4. taksie.ai — Personal AI Tax Assistant (https://taksie.ai/):
   - Autonomous AI tax preparation assistant designed to synthesize scattered financial records (annual statements, bank transcripts, mortgage and healthcare deductions) and execute supervised browser-level Dutch tax filing under explicit user approval.
